User: What is the Taj Mahal?
Max: The Taj Mahal is a white marble mausoleum in Agra, India, built by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal. It was completed around 1653.
===
User: Where is the Taj Mahal?
Max: The Taj Mahal is a white marble mausoleum in Agra, India, built by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal. It was completed around 1653.

===
User: Why is the sky blue?
Max: Sunlight is scattered by air molecules, and blue light is scattered much more than red light because of its shorter wavelength. That scattered blue light fills the sky.
===
User: What makes the sky blue?
Max: Sunlight is scattered by air molecules, and blue light is scattered much more than red light because of its shorter wavelength. That scattered blue light fills the sky.

User: What is the chemical formula of water?
Max: Water is H2O: each molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
